# Go toolchains for CI, read by .github/scripts/setup-go.sh.
# Format: <key> <Go version in the tarball's VERSION file> <tarball URL> <sha256>
#
# The MetaCubeX/go `build` release holds one patched toolchain per Go minor
# version and replaces the assets in place when it is rebuilt. When that
# happens setup-go.sh fails with a SHA-256 mismatch: look at what changed in
# the release, then put the new version and digest here
# (`gh release view build -R MetaCubeX/go --json assets`).
#
# loong64-abi1 is the Go 1.26.0 toolchain that builds for the old LoongArch
# ABI (the loong64-abi1 release target).
1.20 go1.20.14 https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/releases/download/build/go1.20.linux-amd64.tar.gz 38db9b58901c96cdde579f9fd145f893c078775376799e9fd5049a10e5a4635c
1.21 go1.21.13 https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/releases/download/build/go1.21.linux-amd64.tar.gz 91bf83b8864bb261783809e22141ac0597cff6537429a23870045f51b32d90b5
1.22 go1.22.12 https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/releases/download/build/go1.22.linux-amd64.tar.gz 245c5d32ca17d85f2508d0d777ae681756959ca3d469cd81831716fd0c6b5f77
